summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Expo web preview for 'Study Casino' MVP. All 11 requested test items PASSED: boot to Inicio with vintage title, 6-tab navigation, balance/streak/quick actions, Pomodoro timer (25:00 default, duration chips 15/25/50/90 switch correctly, custom input, MODO ALTO RIESGO expands bet-input, EMPEZAR SESIÓN → PAUSAR/ABANDONAR, ABANDONAR shows 'CASINO CERRADO' modal, dismiss returns to idle), Casino cabinet with 3 cherry reels and disabled spin button when coins=0 (button shows 'CERRADO' due to closed banner), Ruleta with all 6 default topics and wheel image visible, Premios with all 7 default rewards + working CRUD ('+ Nuevo' opens edit modal, name+cost+save works, new reward 'Test reward' appears in list), Ajustes with reset-all-button and setting-pomodoroDuration field, and AsyncStorage persistence across page reload (pomodoroDuration=30 survived reload). No backend tested per request. Only issue: non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings in console (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents prop, Image style.resizeMode).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on React Native Web; use 'boxShadow'. Console warning fires on every screen. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (cartoonShadow helper) used in inicio/casino/ruleta/estudio/premios/ajustes.

'textShadow*' style props are deprecated; use 'textShadow' shorthand. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/estudio.tsx:457-460 (timer), casino.tsx:427-430 (cabinetTitle), ruleta.tsx:247-249 (pointerArrow).
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/estudio.tsx:226 (<View ... pointerEvents="none" />).
Image style.resizeMode is deprecated; use props.resizeMode. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/inicio.tsx:257 (quickIcon) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ruleta.tsx:259 (wheelImage).

action_items: Migrate cartoonShadow helper in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to use boxShadow (RN 0.76+/RN Web) instead of shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to silence deprecation warnings.
Replace textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius with the new textShadow shorthand in estudio.tsx (timer), casino.tsx (cabinetTitle), ruleta.tsx (pointerArrow).
In estudio.tsx (line 226), move pointerEvents="none" from prop to style: style={[styles.gaugeShine, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}.
In inicio.tsx (quickIcon) and ruleta.tsx (wheelImage), move resizeMode from StyleSheet to <Image resizeMode="contain" /> prop.
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements correctly use testID (verified via data-testid lookups).
All text is wrapped in <Text> components; no raw strings in <View>.
AsyncStorage persistence works correctly through reload (verified pomodoroDuration=30).
No backend present (local-only AsyncStorage app) – matches MVP spec.
spin-slot-button correctly disables when casino is closed (renders 'CERRADO' label) – verified after a failed study session triggered the cooldown banner.
seed_data_creation: Created one custom reward 'Test reward' (cost=5) via the + Nuevo modal during testing; remains in AsyncStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core MVP flows verified working on https://study-casino.preview.emergentagent.com at mobile viewport 390x844. Only deprecation warnings remain. Note: a previously-abandoned study session leaves the casino in a 30-min closed state in AsyncStorage; future testers may need to clear localStorage or wait for cooldown before re-testing spin flows. testIDs are all wired correctly.
